author: knightlord10
quote:
Grand Theft Auto VI Review: Ruining the Name for Soft, Restrictive **** didn’t like Grand Theft Auto VI at all. It is nothing like the chaos of GTA V. The series used to let you do whatever you wanted. This one is full of rules that stop you from acting **** relationship simulation is bad and removes free will. You are locked into Jason and Lucia’s couple dynamic. There is no real choice to go your own way.
 The writers wrote Jason as a cuck. He stays soft and passive. Lucia’s friends disrespect him and he takes it without proper replies or pushback. There is no wordplay option to fire back. He does not grow into someone with presence. It feels deliberate: Lucia is written as the dominant one while Jason is the weak partner who absorbs everything. GTA does not need that **** cannot do the classic GTA things. There is no prostitution. You cannot shoot randomly in stores or cause unrestricted chaos the way you could in GTA V. The game is restrictive. Violence gets tracked and changes how the world reacts. Store robberies push non-lethal options. Everything steers you back toward approved couple behavior and story limits. 
A normal person plays these games to do prohibited real-world things without consequences. GTA 6 adds too many rules that get in the way.Using the Grand Theft Auto name on this soft, restricted experience is straight-up wrong. If Rockstar wanted a couple drama with a passive male lead and heavy limitations, they should have called it something else. The production is polished, but it ruins the GTA name by ditching the free chaos that defined the series. This is the most restricted entry yet and it does not deserve the title.
